main_text.p: id est, Calumniari, phrasis apud Chaldæos usitatissima. Vide Drusin Quæst. lib. 1. cap. 4. סַלֵּא Loquêtes linguâ linguâ, i.e. unaquaque lingua, seu diversis linguis, Act. 10. 46. Plural. לִשְׁנַיָּא, לִשְׁנִין, לִשָּׁן Syr. לִשַּׁן Linguæ.
אַלְשֵׁן Aphel Ch. Linguâ detrahere, calummniari, Proverb. 30. 10.
מַלְשִׁינוּתָא Ch. Delatio, detractio, calumnia, Psal. 52. 4. & 140. 10.
main_text.head: מ
main_text.p: מָא, מַה Ch. & Syr. Quæ, quod vel quid? מָה רָא Quid hoc? מַן כְּ Quid ad nos? Matth. 27. 5.

מַן כְּ Quid ad te? Johan. 21. 22. Sequente ܡܢ est, Si, quùm, quando: ut מַן Quùm oras, Matth. 6. 5. מַן Idem, Matt. 24. 15. Cum præfixo כ מַן, כְּמָא Quantus, quanta, quantum, pro utroq; genere & numero, Matt. 6. 23. Matth. 27. 13.

Itē Adverbialiter, Quantò: מַן Quantò tò magis? Matt. 7. 11. Est quoque numerale, Quot? Matth. 15. 34. & 16. ver. 9. מַן Quot temporibus, Quoties? Matth. 23. 37. Sequi solet interdum ܡܢ præfixum, & tum significat, Quandiu, Matt. 9. 15. ad Rom. 7. 1. 2. Item Quotiescumque, Matt. 25.

page.notes: Hebrew, Syriac and Chaldee words are printed in Hebrew/Syriac letters with vowel points; the transcription of these scripts is approximate and several Hebrew forms are marked by reconstruction only.
